decisions.why: categories are Cardiopulmonary Exercise Test / Ergometers and examples (Motion Sprint ergometers, Optimise) are CPET diagnostic testing equipment used for pre-op cardiopulmonary assessment
examples (Lovemedical FeNO devices, BlueFlow flow sensor, Spirostik BlueFlow spirometry system) are lung-function diagnostic and spirometry equipment
categories are Cardiopulmonary Exercise Test / Prehab & Rehab Systems and examples (Ambistik CPET, RAM Sport/Athlete ergometers) are CPET diagnostic exercise-testing equipment
examples (Cardiopart 12 WLAN ECG, Amedtec Holter System, Tango M2 ambulatory BP) are specialist cardiac monitoring systems, not disposable ECG electrodes
sole example Ambistik is the same CPET diagnostic exercise-testing device as in the Pre-Operative Assessment and Prehabilitation divisions
